title: Pure Train
summary: Train cards with generic staples, and no Infinitrack or Machina engine. The page's combo replays add Infinitrack, Ancient Gear, Gadget and K9 cards, so they use cards this list leaves out. The 2026 cards lead: Babeldecker Normal Summons without Tributing and brings another EARTH Machine, Night Train Blue Traveler fetches Revolving Switchyard, Exceptional Schedule searches the Schedule Spells, and Flying Launcher and Gustav Rocket top the Rank 10s. Revolving Switchyard turns a Level 4 EARTH Machine from the Deck into a Level 10, so two Level 10s are rarely more than one card away.
main: Heavy Armored Knight Babeldecker
2026 support. Normal Summons without Tributing and summons an EARTH Machine from the hand; becomes a Rank 10 after the opponent activates.
Night Train Blue Traveler
2026 support. Discards itself to fetch Revolving Switchyard or Train Connection; once per Duel, revives itself with another EARTH Machine.
Heavy Freight Train Derricrane
Summons itself when an EARTH Machine arrives; detached as Xyz material, destroys a card.
Night Express Knight
Level 10 that Normal Summons without Tributing.
Super Express Bullet Train
Summons itself while you control only EARTH Machines; returns a Machine from the GY.
Flying Pegasus Railroad Stampede
Summoned: revives an EARTH Machine, and copies Levels for a Rank 10; the 1800 ATK Level 4 Switchyard calls.
Express Train Trolley Olley
Another 1800 ATK Level 4 for Switchyard to turn into a Level 10.
Ruffian Railcar
Sent to the GY: searches a Level 10 EARTH Machine at the End Phase.
Revolving Switchyard
Field Spell: summons a Level 4 EARTH Machine as a Level 10 when a Level 10 arrives; discards to search a Level 10.
Exceptional Schedule
2026 support. Searches Special or Urgent Schedule; from the GY, revives a Level 10 Machine.
Urgent Schedule
Quick-Play: summons a Level 4 and a Level 5+ EARTH Machine from the Deck.
Special Schedule
Revives a 3000 ATK Machine; Set and sent to the GY, returns a Level 10.
Barrage Blast
Detaches materials to destroy that many cards; Flying Launcher searches it.
extra: Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Flying Launcher
2026 support. Rank 10: an extra Machine Normal Summon, searches an EARTH Machine, and pops Spells/Traps.
Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Rocket
2026 support. Rank 10 on top of Gustav Max: negates a monster effect, destroys it, and burns.
Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max
Rank 10: burns for 2000; the base for Gustav Rocket.
Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Juggernaut Liebe
Rank 11 on top of a Rank 10 Machine: attacks once per material.
Number 81: Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Super Dora
Rank 10: makes a monster unaffected for the turn.
Double Headed Anger Knuckle
Link-2: revives a Level 10 Machine from the GY.
Heavy Armored Train Ironwolf
Rank 4 Machine: lets a Machine attack directly.
Number 27: Dreadnought Dreadnoid
Rank 4 that climbs into a Rank 10 Machine after a battle.
Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder
Rank 12: overlays on any Xyz that battled and detaches 2 materials to send all other cards on the field to the GY.
Qliphort Genius
Link-2: immune to Spells/Traps and unaffected by other Link Monsters; negates a face-up card on field and searches Level 5+ Machines.
Infinitrack River Stormer
Rank 5: detaches 1 material to search or send an EARTH Machine to GY; attaches destroyed monsters as material.
